concept: The topographic texture on their site becomes a living map of Málaga's marketing community. Every person is a peak, the cyan wave from their logo is the connection that finds a way between peaks, and joining DMM makes the whole map rise together. It is theirs because the motion itself is built from what is on digitalmarketingmalaga.com: the contour lines, the wave-and-dot mark, the rounded hero cards at different heights, the dark event banners, the pill buttons, the datetime style and the serif logotype.
colour_plan:
There are four fields. Each is entered through an object, and the order follows their homepage: hero, content, footer.

1. **Charcoal #2C2C31 with cyan contour lines at 25–35%, 0–15.1 s.** This is their hero, the map where the problem, the meeting, the community, Málaga and the events play out. The banners' dark halves are the same charcoal, so the banners look printed on the map.
2. **White #F5F5F5, 15.1–23.3 s.** These are their light content pages: event list, team names in cyan, the members page. It grows out of Tatiana Benito's white photo background inside her banner. This is daylight, what you actually get: speakers, sharing, opportunities, the chat. The map continues as pale cyan lines at 30%. Text is charcoal; cyan is kept for names, big words and marks.
3. **Charcoal again, 23.3–30.3 s.** Entered by zooming through the phone's charcoal chat screen: back on the map, now rising, for the viewer's own ambitions.
4. **Full cyan #49D8ED, 30.3–31.1 s.** The film's one accent field: the light pouring through the 'new door', the promise.
5. **Charcoal footer, 31.1–36.4 s.** The cyan field contracts into their JOIN US pill, so the field becomes the button. It reveals the risen landscape behind the end card, like their footer with the logo.

Type is white on charcoal and charcoal on white. Cyan is only for key words, names, the wave and the pill.

scenes.vo: Great marketing starts with great connections, (0.40–2.76)
scenes.idea: On their charcoal contour map, the logo's cyan wave is born from a dot and on 'starts' it sets off across the map. It stretches from one real person (the woman from their hero) to their people (the group from their hero), and the contour lines part to let it through. A connection is a line across their map. The type only labels it.

The wave tries to reach one, runs along a contour into a dead end, and falls short as a flat dashed line.

scenes.idea: The cyan light condenses into their own JOIN US button, which is pressed on 'Join'. The logotype builds above it and the wave comes home after 'Málaga' once more. On 'grow together' every peak on the map rises at once, the separate peaks' contour rings merge into shared ones, and the community cards rise on the peaks around the end card: their homepage hero, now a landscape that grows together.

risks: Kit request, two extra components. (1) TopoLift (S10–S12): the Topo field drawn as stacked contour-level layers on a CSS-3D plane tilted about 30°, each level lifted in Z by its height. It needs raisable peaks at points, rings that spread at a base, merging of lower levels, and billboard cards on summits. Fallback if it looks generic or aliases: flat 2D rings with brightness by height and growing card shadows. (2) DateRoll (S6): the site's 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' datetime as an odometer where only the changing digits roll (tabular figures).

Calm background versus a living map: the contours must act only on events (draw, ripple, ring, part, densify, rise) and otherwise drift no more than about 8 px/s. A full-frame field that keeps wobbling will read as decorative motion and fight the foreground.

Thin cyan lines at 25–35% on charcoal shimmer at 60 fps and band in H.264. Keep strokes at least 2 px at 1080p, keep the contours stable over time (smooth noise, no marching-squares popping) and add the static dither.
S2's meaning (dense contours = steep = hard) may not read for viewers who can't read maps. The failed dashed wave and the blurred far cards must carry it; check this on the contact sheet.

The woman in the Málaga street (hero photo) plays 'you': alone in S2, ambitions in S10, end card. If she is a specific member or organiser, showing her isolated may be awkward, so confirm with Karl. Diego (organiser) on the door stays unlabelled.

Source sizes. DMM03 is 589 px (show at most 765 px), the cathedral 714 px (at most 928), the Nicole banner 697 px and alexandra.jpeg 564 px. The logo PNG (302 px) and dmm-icon (159 px) are too small, so use only the live Logo and Wave. Speaker portraits are crops of the 2026 banner right halves (sharp at 0.5x); crop above the printed name captions. Charcoal's grey photo background must still read as a card on #F5F5F5.
The task notes call 2025_04_WhatsApp-Image an event crowd. It is actually the Ruben Llorach banner ('B2B shouldn't mean Being Too Boring'), so don't use it as a crowd photo.

No invented chat content. Bubbles carry only real site images (banners, event photos) and the wave typing indicator. No message text, no WhatsApp logo or green UI; the header shows only 'Digital Marketing Málaga' and 'About 240 active members' (fact).
Every listed event is in the past (the latest is 2026-10-15; today is 2026-11-02), so never label them 'Upcoming' even though the site does.
Cyan on #F5F5F5 is about 1.7:1. The site uses it for team names, but at 50 px it may be weak; fall back to charcoal names with a cyan wave underline if the sheet reads poorly.
S6 shows three banners in about 0.9 s, too fast to read their headlines. The beat is 'many fresh ideas', and the front banner (Tatiana) holds for 1.6 s.
The end card is dense: logo, line, pill, address and four side cards on a 3D landscape. If the contact sheet looks busy, cut the side cards to two or set them to 70% opacity.
The door swing (rotateY) and the billboards in a tilted world need one consistent perspective; build the door in camera space, not in the tilted plane.

The logo's serif font is unidentified. Pick from films/dmm/plan/ttf (Gelasio, Libre Caslon Text, Lora, Literata, Source Serif 4, ...) by overlaying candidates on 2024_12_DMM-logo-dark.png before building S3 and S12.
Motion norm (7%): the white stretch in S7, with three mid-size portraits, is the likeliest dip. The ripples and card rises there must be large.
The only zoom-through (S9→S10) is off-centre. The phone must glide to the centre while scaling ×4.5 so its screen covers the full 1920 px width at the cut.

About 27 of 36 s are charcoal (their hero and footer colour), against Karl's default of bright and no standard dark background. It is justified as their signature and the map is never static, but if he wants more light, S10–S11 can run on white with charcoal contours.
